summary: PR 7349 backfilled module-owned metadata.json files across the repository and guarded publishing workflows against metadata-only changes. It merged after one approval from jtracey93.
proposed: Add initial module-owned metadata directly to this repository, allow metadata review by either engineering or module owners, and keep metadata-only changes out of automatic publishing.
changed: The PR adds 572 metadata.json files (222 roots, 350 children) with a flat owners array and no schemaVersion or tier authored. It ends .github/CODEOWNERS with a metadata.json rule naming the engineering-owners and module-owners teams, either of which can approve, and appends !avm/**/metadata.json to all 217 per-module publishing workflows. The unpublished internal avm/ptn/ai-ml/ai-foundry/modules/project helper was excluded.
shipped: The metadata files, the CODEOWNERS rule and the workflow path exclusions merged in one commit.
